Welcome to LB Fresh.

LB Fresh ("we", "our", "us", or "the Company"), operated by LB Mart, provides an online grocery shopping and delivery platform through our official website (https://lbfreshbasket.com/) and our LB Fresh Android mobile application (the "App").

This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, share, and protect your personal information when you visit our website, use our mobile application, place orders, or interact with our services.
By accessing or using LB Fresh, you acknowledge that you have read and understood this Privacy Policy.
We collect only the information necessary to provide grocery ordering, delivery, and customer support services.

ul.li: Full name
Mobile phone number (used for OTP verification and delivery coordination)
Email address
Account credentials and encrypted authentication/session tokens

div.p: When you save an address or place an order, we collect:

ul.li: House, flat, or building number
Street, landmark, and locality
City, district, state, and PIN code
Delivery instructions and recipient contact number
Order ID, order date, and time
Purchased products, quantities, and cart preferences
Order status, delivery logs, cancellations, and refund records
Billing and tax invoice details

div.p: LB Fresh supports multiple payment methods, including UPI, debit cards, credit cards, net banking, digital wallets, and Cash on Delivery (COD).

ul.li: Online payments are processed securely through PCI-DSS compliant third-party payment gateway providers (such as Razorpay).
We receive transaction reference IDs, payment status, payment method type, and refund details.

li.strong: We do not collect, process, or store your full credit/debit card numbers, CVV, UPI PINs, or net banking passwords on our servers.

div.p: When you use the LB Fresh mobile application, we automatically collect limited technical data to ensure app stability, security, and order notifications:

ul.li: Device model, manufacturer, and Android operating system version
App version and network connection information
IP address and unique device/app instance identifiers
Push notification tokens (via Google Firebase Cloud Messaging) to send real-time order updates
Application crash reports, error logs, and diagnostic performance metrics
With your explicit permission, we may access your device's approximate or precise GPS location solely to help you pin your accurate delivery address and verify serviceability in your area.
We do not track your background location when the app is not in use. You can enable or revoke location access at any time through your Android device settings.

div.p: When you contact us for support, we collect your name, phone number, email address, order details, and any messages or attachments you share to resolve your issue.
We use the collected information strictly for legitimate business purposes:

ul.li: To create, verify, and manage your LB Fresh customer account.
To process, pack, and deliver your grocery orders accurately.
To process online payments, Cash on Delivery settlements, cancellations, and refunds.
To send essential transactional communications (OTPs, order confirmations, and delivery status alerts).
To provide customer support and resolve order or product issues.
To monitor app performance, fix crashes, prevent fraud, and maintain platform security.
To comply with applicable Indian tax, food safety, and legal obligations.

div.h3: 4. Sharing of Personal Information & Third-Party Services

p.strong: We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal information to third parties.

div.p: We share necessary data only with trusted third-party service providers required to operate LB Fresh:

ul.li: Payment Gateway Providers (e.g., Razorpay): To securely process online payments, verify transactions, and issue refunds.
Delivery & Logistics Personnel: Your name, delivery address, phone number, and order summary are shared with assigned delivery partners strictly to complete your delivery.
Cloud Hosting & Infrastructure Providers: Secure servers and database hosting providers used to operate our website, mobile application, and backend ERP systems.
Notification & Diagnostic Services (e.g., Google Firebase): Used to deliver push notifications for order updates and collect anonymous crash diagnostics to improve app stability.
SMS & Communication Gateways: Used to send login OTPs and essential order alerts.
Government & Legal Authorities: Information may be disclosed when required by applicable Indian law, court order, or valid regulatory request.

div.p: All third-party providers are bound by confidentiality and data security obligations.
We implement industry-standard technical and organizational safeguards to protect your personal data against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or loss, including:

ul.li: Encryption of data in transit using HTTPS / TLS protocols.
Role-based access controls and strict authentication checks.
Secure database management and regular encrypted backups.
Continuous security monitoring and vulnerability patching.

div.p: While we take strong precautions to protect your data, no method of electronic transmission or storage is 100% immune to risk.
We retain your personal information only for as long as your account is active or as reasonably necessary to fulfil the purposes outlined in this Policy.
Certain records may be retained after account closure where required by law or legitimate business necessity, including:

ul.li: Tax invoices, GST records, and financial transaction logs.
Dispute resolution, fraud prevention, and legal compliance records.

div.p: Once retention periods expire, personal data is securely deleted or irreversibly anonymized.
You have the right to delete your LB Fresh account and associated personal data at any time using either of the following methods:

ol.li: Open the LB Fresh mobile application and log into your account.
Go to Account / Profile → Settings → Delete Account.
Confirm your request to initiate permanent account deletion.

div.h4: Option 2: Web or Email Deletion Request
div.p: If you have uninstalled the app or cannot access your account:

ul.li: Visit our dedicated Account Deletion page: https://lbfreshbasket.com/delete-account
Or email us at lbfreshbasket@gmail.com from your registered email address (or include your registered mobile number) with the subject line: Account Deletion Request – LB Fresh.
Processing Time: Upon verifying your identity, we will permanently delete your account, profile details, saved addresses, and login credentials within 30 days.

Retained Records: Completed order invoices and payment transaction records required for statutory tax, accounting, and fraud-prevention compliance under Indian law will be retained in restricted storage and will not be used for any other purpose.
Once completed, account deletion is permanent and cannot be undone.

div.p: Our website (https://lbfreshbasket.com/) uses essential cookies and session storage to keep you logged in, preserve your shopping cart, remember preferences, and analyze site performance. You can control or disable cookies through your browser settings, though certain site features may not function properly without them.

Our website or app may contain links to external third-party websites or payment portals. We are not responsible for the privacy practices or content of independent third-party services and encourage you to review their respective privacy policies.

ul.li: Transactional Alerts: We send essential service notifications regarding OTP logins, order confirmations, delivery updates, and refunds.

Promotional Communications: Where permitted by law, we may send offers or discount alerts. You can opt out of promotional notifications at any time via the app notification settings or your Android device settings.

div.p: LB Fresh is intended for users aged 18 and older. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 18. If we discover that personal data from a minor has been collected inadvertently, we will promptly delete it.
Under applicable Indian privacy laws, including the Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act, 2023, you have the right to:

ul.li: Access a summary of the personal data we hold about you.
Correct or update inaccurate profile or address information.
Request erasure/deletion of your account and personal data.
Withdraw consent for optional device permissions (such as location or promotional notifications).
Nominate another individual to exercise your rights in the event of death or incapacity, as permitted under Indian law.
File a grievance or complaint regarding data handling.

div.p: To exercise any of these rights, contact our Grievance & Privacy Officer using the details in Section 15.

This Privacy Policy is governed by the laws of India, including the Information Technology Act, 2000, the Information Technology (Reasonable Security Practices and Procedures and Sensitive Personal Data or Information) Rules, 2011, and the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023.
We may update this Privacy Policy periodically to reflect changes in our app features or legal requirements. Any updates will be published directly on this official page:
The updated policy will display a revised "Last Updated" date at the top of the page.
For any questions, privacy requests, or grievances regarding your personal data, please contact:

ul.li: Application Name: LB Fresh
Operated By: LB Mart
Business Address: Therpet Road, Near Government Hospital, Denkanikottai, Tamil Nadu – 635107, India

div.p: By registering on or using the LB Fresh website or Android mobile application, you signify your acceptance of this Privacy Policy. If you do not agree with the terms described above, please discontinue using our application and services.
